title: Canvas vector export
summary: Extended configuration export with vector snapshots of the rendered design view.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2023-11-15. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Added SVG export of the rendered design canvas through XML serialization and downloadable Blob/object URLs, enabling vector snapshots of engineering views.
Integrated canvas-image export into the configuration export dialog and subsequently refined dialog behavior.
At the captured HEAD, SVG export is conditional on a logical-mesh SVG element; PNG paths serve other available canvases. Historical SVG work does not establish universal Pixi vector export support.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
